get.description:
Returns the stokvel, the caller's role in it, the member count and a summary of the current cycle.
404 for a non-member, an unknown id and a malformed id alike, so the answer never confirms
that a stokvel exists.

put.summary: Update a stokvel's name and contribution amount
put.description: Stokvel Admin only. Does not affect existing members or past contributions.

delete.description: Stokvel Admin only. Does not delete related ContributionCycles; they remain orphaned. See the README's Definition of Done table.

post.summary: Process the next eligible payout for a cycle
post.description:
Treasurer or Admin of the stokvel only. Picks the earliest-joined member who hasn't received
a payout from this stokvel yet, records the payout, and marks the cycle as processed. Both
writes happen inside one transaction; fails 404 if either resource does not exist, 409 if
the cycle is already processed or no eligible member remains.

get.summary: The signed-in user's own contributions in one stokvel
get.description:
Newest first, paged as { items, nextPageToken } (an empty nextPageToken means no more results).
Only the caller's own contributions are returned, so no other member's amount or id is exposed.
Money is integer cents; recordedAt is a UTC instant; status is Pending, Paid or Confirmed.

get.summary: Every cycle of one stokvel, newest first
get.description:
Status is Open, Closed (closed by the cycle-close job) or PaidOut. dueDate is the cycle's end date
as a calendar date (null for undated cycles). collectedCents is everything recorded against the
cycle; amountDueCents is the cycle's target amount. Money is integer cents.

get.summary: The members of one stokvel, with their names
get.description:
Treasurer or Admin of the stokvel only, because it lists other members' names. This is what the
frontend's member picker uses when a Treasurer records a contribution on someone's behalf.
Paged as { items, nextPageToken } (an empty nextPageToken means no more results).

get.summary: A stokvel's contributions, filtered and paged
get.description:
Members see only their own contributions (asking for another member is 403). Treasurers and Admins
see everyone's. Filters: member (a member id; an id that is not in this stokvel gives an empty list),
from and to (UTC instants such as 2026-09-30T22:00:00Z; from is included, to is excluded; a date
without a time is 400) and sort (newest or oldest). Paged as { items, nextPageToken }. A pageToken
only works with the filters it came from; with different filters the answer is 400.

get.summary: Recent activity across the caller's stokvels
get.description:
Contributions, payouts and members joining, across the stokvels the caller belongs to, newest first,
paged as { items, nextPageToken }. A Member sees only their own contributions; a Treasurer or Admin
sees everyone's in their stokvels. Names of other people are shown only to Treasurers and Admins.

post.summary: Create an invite code for a stokvel
post.description: Treasurer or Admin of the stokvel only. expiresInDays is 1 to 30 (default 7).

put.summary: Set the rules shown to people previewing an invite

get.description: Returns the stokvel's name, rules, contribution amount, schedule and member COUNT. No names, balances or payout order. 404 unknown code, 410 expired code.

post.summary: Join a stokvel with an invite code
post.description: Joins as a Member. 409 (code already-member, with stokvelId) if the caller is already in. Repeating the request never makes a second membership.

post.summary: Attach (or replace) a proof of payment
post.description: The contribution's owner or a Treasurer/Admin of the stokvel. JPEG, PNG or PDF, up to 5 MB, judged by the file's bytes. 409 once the cycle is closed. Anyone else gets 404.

delete.summary: Remove a proof of payment (cycle still open)

get.description: Only the uploader and Treasurers/Admins of the stokvel the contribution belongs to. Everyone else: 404.

get.summary: Preview what closing a cycle will do
get.description: Treasurer or Admin only. Who goes into arrears and by how much, as of which South African date, plus a version to send back when closing. Uses the same code as the real close.

post.summary: Close a cycle exactly as previewed
post.description: Treasurer or Admin only. Needs an Idempotency-Key and the version from the preview. 409 (code stale-preview) if anything changed since; 409 (code already-closed) if closed. The same key answers with the first result and Idempotency-Replayed: true.

get.description: Returns every user currently stored. Never fails; an empty store returns an empty array.

put.summary: Update a user's name and email
put.description: Does not change isActive; there is no endpoint to activate or deactivate a user yet.

delete.description: Does not check whether the user belongs to any stokvel; deleting a user does not remove their membership records.

post.description: Password must be at least 12 characters. A duplicate email returns 409.

Returns a short-lived access token and sets the refresh token as an HttpOnly cookie. An unknown email and a wrong password return the same 401. Too many attempts from one IP return 429 with Retry-After.

post.summary: Exchange the refresh cookie for a new access token
post.description: The refresh token works exactly once; a new one is set in the cookie. Any failure returns the same 401.
Revokes the session's refresh tokens and clears the cookie. Always returns 204, so calling it twice, or with no cookie, is harmless.

get.description: Platform admins only. Returns every stokvel with its member count.

post.description:
Any signed-in user may create a stokvel and becomes its Admin.
contributionAmount must be strictly greater than zero.
Example request:
{ "name": "Holiday Savings", "contributionAmount": 500 }

post.summary: Add a user as a stokvel member
post.description:
Stokvel Admin only. Fails if the stokvel or user does not exist (404), if the user is already
a member (409), or if the user is inactive (409). New members join with the Member role.
Example request:
{ "userId": "..." }

delete.summary: Remove a member from a stokvel
delete.description: Stokvel Admin only. 404 if the stokvel does not exist, or if the given user is not currently a member.

post.summary: Record a member's contribution for a cycle
post.description:
Members may record their own contribution. Treasurer or Admin may record anyone's (403 otherwise).
amountInCents is a whole number of cents (50000 is R500.00), from 1 to 100 000 000.
Requires an Idempotency-Key header, scoped to the caller and the stokvel. Repeating the same key
with the same body returns the original response unchanged, with an Idempotency-Replayed: true
header. Repeating the same key with a different body returns 422.
Rate limited per user (429 with Retry-After). A 429 never consumes the key, so retry with the
same key after the wait.
Fails 404 if the stokvel, user, or contribution cycle does not exist, or if the cycle belongs
to a different stokvel. Fails 409 if the user is not a member, or has already contributed for
this cycle.
Example request:
{ "userId": "...", "contributionCycleId": "...", "amountInCents": 50000 }

get.description: Returns the cycles of every stokvel the caller belongs to. Platform admins see every cycle.

post.summary: Create a contribution cycle for a stokvel
post.description:
Treasurer or Admin of the stokvel only. 404 if stokvelId does not refer to a stokvel the caller
belongs to. targetAmount must be greater than zero.
Example request:
{ "stokvelId": "...", "label": "2026-09", "targetAmount": 500 }

get.summary: Get a contribution cycle by id

put.summary: Update a contribution cycle's label and target amount
put.description: Treasurer or Admin of the stokvel only. Does not allow moving a cycle to a different stokvel; stokvelId in the body is ignored on update.

delete.description: Stokvel Admin only. Does not check for existing contributions recorded against this cycle. See the README's Definition of Done table.

get.description: Returns the caller's own profile and never a password hash. Their role in each stokvel comes from /me/home.

One entry per stokvel the caller belongs to: name, the caller's role name, the current cycle
(newest cycle that is not yet paid out), what the caller paid and still owes this cycle, and the
next payout date in UTC. Money is integer cents. A user in no stokvels gets 200 with an empty list.
Only the caller's own amounts are returned.
